First, note that time zones as we know them did not exist in 1589.  
But for the purpose of this exercise, we assume modern time zone rules applied historically.  

Australia/Sydney is UTC+10 (or UTC+11 with DST, but DST not in effect in January).  
6 PM Sydney time = 18:00 Sydney time (UTC+10).  
UTC = 18:00 − 10 h = 08:00 UTC on the same date.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1589-01-26 08:00
